Diffusion LLMs just reached 1,068 tokens per second with a 1M-token context window.

Here are the major AI developments you should know about today:

⚡ Inception released Mercury 3, a diffusion LLM capable of generating 1,068 tokens per second alongside a 1M-token context. Inception reports that Mercury 3 outperforms GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on 8 out of 12 evaluated benchmarks.

💻 OpenAI is focusing on low-resource programming languages, adding new evaluation suites for ChatGPT that cover software engineering, SQLite, and legacy COBOL migration tasks.

🏛️ Anthropic has pledged 5% to a Public Benefit Fund ahead of its upcoming IPO, setting a distinct precedent for corporate governance among top frontier labs.

⚖️ Anthropic is also asking courts to decide legal boundaries regarding when AI development or operation should stop.

👔 Google updated Gemini with features allowing users to style outfits by virtually placing a person into different clothing items directly within the user interface.

As a developer, seeing model speed push past 1,000 tokens per second while context lengths remain at 1M tokens changes how we architect real-time LLM pipelines.

At the same time, seeing benchmarks targeted specifically at COBOL migration and low-resource languages shows where enterprise engineering effort is actually going.

Which of these updates do you think will impact your current development workflow the most?
